div.div:
Critical questions the architect must answer
Q1. Two users click the last seat at the same instant. Who wins?
Seat ownership is a single-writer problem. Atomic hold in Redis plus a unique(show_id, seat_id) constraint in SQL as the final guard. A cache alone is never trusted to prevent double booking.
Q2. What if the user holds seats and walks away?
Holds are leases with a TTL. Payment window must be shorter than the lease; expiry releases seats automatically. No lease means inventory leaks.
